sentence_stem: If only I had studied harder,
correct_completion: I would have passed the exam.
full_sentence: If only I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
acceptable_variants: I would have got a higher score.
I would have done much better.

options.text: I would pass the exam tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This uses a future time reference, but 'had studied' refers to the past, so the completion should describe a past result.
This describes a present habit. It does not complete the past regret set up by 'If only I had studied'.

options.text: I would have passed the exam.

options.why_wrong: This describes the exam, not the speaker's regret about what could have happened.

grammar_focus: Third conditional with 'if only' to express past regret
explanation: The stem uses 'if only' with a past perfect to express regret about the past, so the completion needs 'would have' followed by a past participle. Ukrainian speakers may be tempted to use a simple past here because their past conditional is built with a separate particle rather than an auxiliary verb.
translation: Якби я лише вчився більше, я б склав іспит.
